phase-3.title: Build
phase-3.text: For each work item the script serves validate-existing, implement, test and document in order, each as an Until Loop whose contract the script writes and whose terminal packet it checks. validate-existing runs the step plan's expectation checks on the item base and is skipped when every one matches; implement runs one packet per step, each followed by an Improve child and the lint gate; test proves the new tests fail on the base checkout and pass on the candidate; document runs only when the change is behavioural. A revise outcome returns through the script to step-plan for a replan.

phase-4.title: Verify
phase-4.short: Rerun every check, commit the item
phase-4.text: The script reruns every recorded test command and the lint gate on the item's candidate, always, and commits the verified item.

phase-5.title: Carry forward
phase-5.text: Once per work item the model records lessons, decides whether a skill is reused, updated or created (the script commits a created or updated skill), and revises the remaining queue before the next item's step plan.

phase-6.title: System test
phase-6.text: The whole product is tested for real against the spec's acceptance criteria, by tests the script requires and checks.

phase-7.title: Release
phase-7.text: The script serves the release plan, check, release and verification stages, then operations and handoff, and ends the run with a report.

stages.purpose: Map the request to outcomes, boundaries and open questions in this result's `summary`.
Inspect the repository and baseline tests; write the facts to KNOWLEDGE/environment.md and the baseline run to `evidence_refs`.
Resolve the consequential unknowns with evidence in RUN/notes/research.md; durable facts go to KNOWLEDGE/environment.md.
Define each requirement and its acceptance lines as R-<n> in KNOWLEDGE/spec.md; ShipLoop derives this run's ID changes from the spec diff.
Map each requirement to the checks that prove it: harnesses and commands in KNOWLEDGE/environment.md, boundaries in KNOWLEDGE/architecture.md.
Plan dependencies and the queue: ordered `work_items`, `assumptions`, and structure decisions in KNOWLEDGE/architecture.md.
Ready the development and test environment; record readiness in KNOWLEDGE/environment.md and runner output in `evidence_refs`.
Plan this item's change: `criteria`, `steps`, `test_commands`; `expectations`, `paths`, `follows` in the result.
Specify this item's tests: one `test_cases` row per focused-command ID, with oracle, RED and GREEN. Write no test code.
Resolve each expectation that mismatched on the item base: fix it in WORKTREE or report send-back with `failed_expectations`.
Make this step's change in WORKTREE; exit codes go to RUN/notes/<action>.md, uncovered behaviour to `not_covered`.
Build out this step's part of the test spec: a test per quoted case, titled with its ID; make every recorded command pass in WORKTREE; fields go in the result.
Update the docs this step's change affects in WORKTREE from observed behaviour; no-change reasons go to RUN/notes/<action>.md.
Accept the item: confirm each criterion after the last edit, trace entry points; review the diff; notes in RUN/notes/<action>.md.
Close the item: update the knowledge home; the future queue in `work_items`; the reusable-skill decision in `skill`.
Author the system tests: catalog and integrated plan in `summary`, `system_commands`, unrunnable cases in `assumptions`.
Run the recorded system tests on the assembled candidate: end states in `summary`, command output in `evidence_refs`.
Assess the product against the request: each outcome's end state in `summary`, gaps in `unverified`, missing work as add-work.
Plan the release without performing it: steps and rollback in `summary` and KNOWLEDGE/environment.md, `consumer_checks`, `consumer_entry`.
Confirm the candidate is release-ready without releasing: dry run and confirm commands once, results in `summary` and `evidence_refs`.
Perform the planned release; record its effect and the artifact's identity in `summary` and `evidence_refs`.
Observe the released result where consumers use it; outcomes in `summary` and `evidence_refs`, run lessons in `lessons`.
Confirm the release can be monitored, recovered and supported: evidence in `summary`, locators in KNOWLEDGE/environment.md.
Write the final handoff in `summary`: status per area with locators in `evidence_refs`, plus limits and open items.
